faq:
What is the minimum order?

50 pieces (or 50 kits).

Can I see a sample first?

Yes. We send a free digital mockup within 24 hours, and then a physical sample with your logo.

Can you engrave each person's name?

Yes — names, vehicle numbers or IDs on every piece. We'll ask you to approve the name list in writing before engraving.

Do prices include GST?

Yes, all prices include GST, and we provide a GST invoice.

How do I pay?

A 50% advance confirms a bulk order; first-time orders are paid fully in advance.

Can you print in colour?

Our laser engraving is single-tone and permanent. For full-colour logos, ask us — we can arrange it.

How long does it take?

Usually 5–10 working days after sample approval, depending on quantity. We'll confirm a date before you order.

Do you deliver outside Ajmer?

Yes, we deliver across India.

Still have a question? Ask us on WhatsApp.
